tiv_text: Ka we a tsemben orapirashe iyou ú tungwan hondo.

A lu er u ngu tsemben iyou man tungwan hondo yô tese er we u ngu yan ga. Man er i lu iyou ki orapirashe yô, maa nan a na jighjigh je er we u ngu a kwagh ken zwa ga. Shi u ngu bumen nan ga. Ka we a eren kwagh a or u nan fe ga yô, u eren waang sha er nan a hen er we u ngu nzughul a nan ga yô.

tiv_text: Ka we a wuhwan orapirashe iyol u lu nan jingi.
english_translation: When you are dressing a blind man, you are his mirror.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen u sõron anngbyan jime. Zum u anngbyan alu nengen kwagh u u lu eren sha ci na ga la, ka u er sha mimi.

tiv_text: Ka we a zendan orapirashe hen ya wou yo, u kende nan aga ken won.
english_translation: When you are sending a blind man out of your house, first throw out his walking stick.
deeper_meaning: Zum u u kaa a orapirashe wer nan a due hen ya wou sha man u tee gbogh ku nan u kende ken won je, maa ka nan fa er kuma sha mimi ve. Tiv mba er injakwagh ne sha u tesen er, i ôron i luun a ieren sha min.

tiv_text: Orapirashe u a ngohol imenger yô, ngu tuhwan iyolna.
english_translation: A blind man who carries a lamp is mocking himself.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh or. ne u vendan imbwase i kaan

tiv_text: Avange u pirinashe yô Aôndo koson un iyolna.
english_translation: It is God who feeds a blind lizard.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne sha u tesen ishima i wan sha akaa. Tese er ka we a amber sha akaa ga u va zua a kwagh. Or u a lu a iniôngon iyol ga kpaa gbenda u waren ka u lu.

tiv_text: TingeBagu tse ku ka myenge.
english_translation: An old monkey lives long because of its watchfulness.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne sha u tesen mlu u tsevtsev man sulaa sha hanma kwagh. Ka u wan ityogh eren akaa a u henen sha mi ga.

tiv_text: Ivaan i í ker sha ada ú mimi ga, ngi te kwagh ga, ka i hide i tume zwa inya.
english_translation: An arrow not shot from a truthful bow does not hit the target.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba hembe õron injakwagh ne shie u ve lu wan wan kwagh sha inyaregh ki zuan a mi sha mimi ga yõ. Ka ve tese er, kwagh u zuan a mi sha mimi ga ka a za gwa kpishi kpa a lu gbem ga, shi m kur na a doo ga.

tiv_text: Ka we a mende akuzwa u kera fehen usu ga.
english_translation: Once you have a moustache, you no longer blow on the fire.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne sha u vendan iyongo i hiin. Ka ve tese er se kpa se mar ônov nahan se de kera hiin iyongo ga. Shin se penda kor yongo yô ia lu sha ityogh ki mbayev asev. Paregh kwagh u vihin sha er u va lu a mzeyol ga yô.

tiv_text: Akuzwa doon hodon iombor ga, ka i mir an-mnger keng.
english_translation: A moustache is not good to be shaved when it is dry; wet it first.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen er naagh ku de yinan we ga. U nan ga la hemba vihin. Voogh er u kende an-mnger sha ice i sha zwa ga u kember a nyoon we nahan.

tiv_text: Avange u a undu Haa yô, kera ngu wanye ga. Tiv mba soon u tesen ken injakwagh ne er, we a lu cuku kpa ityő a kende a we sha yõ ieren you i de tesen yev ga. Tor u ityo you i neu la we u tsev a kua ken shima.
english_translation: A lizard that climbs a mahogany tree is no longer a baby.

tiv_text: Ayôôso a ken kasua nga yangen ivyo ngeren ga. Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen er mjirim ma yangen tom ga. Mzeyol shin mbamtaver ve de yangen we kwagh u u soo u eren ga.
english_translation: The noise in the market square does not stop a goat from drinking water.

tiv_text: Mba Aõndo A kende ve tsar yô, ve a vihi vanger sha mboho ga kpa ve a per.
english_translation: Those for whom God has made a bridge do not crawl across Gardenia erubescens.
deeper_meaning: Ibohogh ka kon u ka u nongo u lun hen kpe uaghee yô. Ka ki nôngo u nguran kpishi nahan ashie gbing ka i kôr wegh sha mi i per uagh zum u tsar u lu ga yô. Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u pasen er mba Aôndo a ne ve ikyôr yô ve a ya ican keng man ve a zua a kwagh ga.

tiv_text: Anyigôr u atem ya ken Mngishi vaan ijen ga. Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen er anye u alu ya sha agbur tolugh ga. Tese er u ngu ken ato u kwagh nahan kwagh un a ban u ga.
english_translation: A worm that builds its home inside a garden egg never cries from hunger.

tiv_text: Aôndo u a hee u kpesa la un a nau akuur a aan.
english_translation: The God who gives you an itch will also give you fingernails to scratch it.
deeper_meaning: Kpesa ka avav a cuku-cuku. Ka a agher kpishi. Tiv mba er kwagh on tesen er Aondo un a nau ican yô, un a hide at a gbenda u wasen we ican shon, shin yiman we.

tiv_text: Anjande ú ágbeityő a nyer ken kungô ifi lun a akambe tseegh ga anshuuv kpa ka ve lu. Tiv mba er kwagh ne, u tesen er kwagh banen wan shin anngbyan u Tor ga. Or u nan we ndor a ornyar cii kwagh un a ban nan ga.
english_translation: A stream that flows into a river has not only crabs but fish as well.

tiv_text: Mba wuese nguhar môm mtum ga. Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen er mba er ijir vegher mõm ga. Avegher la cii ka a tema her i ungwa akaaõron a ve cii.
english_translation: They do not praise only one calf.

tiv_text: Tse-ihyundu kera keren awen ga, ka a kohol a kohol awen.
english_translation: A man who has been mad for a long time no longer throws stones; instead, he gathers them.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u pasen er ka we a va hingir orya shin organden u kera hiin iyongo ga, ka u waan a wa kwagh, shin u sôron a sôr tar.

tiv_text: Úmenden anyi a kôkônan ka kwagh u bo ga, ka u lun a akuzwa ú cilin ga la, i lu iyongo ú lu hiin ior ye.
english_translation: Having long teeth is not the problem; the problem is not having enough lips to cover them.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er kwagh ne sha u pasen er we a lu a agee a maren mbayev kpishi yô, shi u lu a agee a koson ve. Shi we a fa wer u wa kwagh ave u un a va gande u yô, guda we u de hiin ga.

tiv_text: Iywa i ilu i ape fan ikyōr yö, i keghen hondo ga. Ka a gbilen gbuuka sha avande tsô maa i lu sha gbenda.
english_translation: A dog that wants to become a great hunter does not wait for the hunter's whistle. The moment the hunter shoulders his gun, the dog follows.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u pasen er or u nan lu a kwaghfan u marami nan keghen er i wa a wa nan kwagh man nan a er ga, ka nan a nengen ajinge tso maa nan bee shima je.

tiv_text: Iywa i í sôôn u kpen i kera ongo myel u orywa ga.
english_translation: A dog that wishes to die does not respond to its master's call.
deeper_meaning: Tiv 300 u tesen er or u alu u saan ishe yô, kera ongo kwaghwan ga. Ka nan norom sha kwagh bo. Nan ongo icintan kpaa ga.

tiv_text: Ka we a gbongor ityogh,iywa you kpa i gbehe u. Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen er ka we a gba ican kwase wou kpa anyiman we. Shie gen u za ii nahan teru shin ngôu kpa un a nyiman er un fa u ga.
english_translation: Once you shave your head, even your dog can bark at you.

tiv_text: Mba gberen akpa mba gbidi ishegh taav man i bughun ga, ka i lu ihyôwe.
english_translation: A snuffbox is not opened by striking it with a cane; it is opened with a finger.
deeper_meaning: Zum u mba mankuretaav ka ve a soo u bughun Ishegh yô, ka ve kema ihyowe sha kughur na la tsetse sha er taav la, un a lu sha kur na kpa un a hide a kohol shimi yô. Tiv mba er kwagh ne sha u kaan er ka u ôron kwagh sha agee shin sha utaha ve ior a ungwa ga. Shin ka u ôron gbem ve or ongo kwaghwan ga.

tiv_text: Ka u shin sha ambi gbem man i nyie igyôm ga, ka i mar a mar or nyian igyöm ken uya je.
english_translation: It is not how long you spend defecating that determines how big your stool will be. Some people are simply born to pass big stools.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne sha u kaan er, ka zer-ôron kwagh gbem ve or ongo ga. Ka injakwagh shon imôm ka ve kaa er "Iyö i nyom i saan ityogh her, manve or kee ga" ye.

tiv_text: Saa ava a icor shin jande cii man a kure kor ga.
english_translation: You do not have to bring the whole raffia palm out of the stream before you can finish weaving a rope.
deeper_meaning: Heen kpa Tiv mba kaan er saa hanma or nan a lam ver a kure lyam/kwkagh ga. Shin u zer lamen gbem ver ú va ôr itine kwagh ga.

tiv_text: Se mir ityogh se ver ashe sha a we, ka we u lu a atsem ye u mase gbongor.
english_translation: We have already wet our heads; all that remains is for you to shave us, since you are the one with the safety razor.
deeper_meaning: Tiv ngise ve haa mngerem shin ityo cii ve i hondo ye. Shi iyange i hondo sha atsem. Atsem iyange a lu je er ka lezôr nahan kpa a gema a hor tsa kera i kôr wegh sha mi i hondon ityogh. Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen er ve ver ishima ve sha or. Ka u geman iyol ve cii wan sha ikyev i or. Gbashima u nan cii ka sha a we, ka we u lu myima u nan ye.

tiv_text: Iji i ílu i ape kpen ga yô, i tem sha ishuugh
english_translation: A housefly that does not want to die always sit on a broom.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba hembe õron injakwagh ne u tesen iyol paregh. Ka we a soo wer kwagh a va tseru ga yo, u wa iyol sha iyolyou. Voogh er u soo wer Agina a va hen ya wou ga yô, ka u gber iwambe, we kua ya wou cii.

tiv_text: Mkange ikpya Shimbe zwa m kende shin mnger ve, tese se amborboso
english_translation: I tied the mouth of an aardvark-skin bag and dropped it into the stream. The one who is up will show the bubbles.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba hembe ôron injakwagh ne u pasen er, ve ve nôngo kwagh ne sha mnenge ve, kwagh un a shi yô orgen nan a mase kuren. Ka u tesen er nan fa bee ga, shin nan shar ve, orgen nan a mase kôngor.

tiv_text: Ka we a dugh ityôndo gbaaye u ngôôr zende ga. Ityondo gbaaye ka kon u ú ngôôr pirin usu ga yô.
english_translation: Whoever carries a burning stick of African mesquite does not waste time on the journey home.
deeper_meaning: Ka nahan man or ngu a za dugh hen anngbyan er nan a za keer yô nan yemen fele fele je er ua va pir. Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen er, ka we a lu a mzeyol yo u lanen ayom ou ga. Hanma kwagh u a tseru yô u lanen cigh nagh ga

tiv_text: M kor bua sha akor we u ngu kamen atumba (Me kör bua sha akor we kam atumba).
english_translation: I have seized the bull by its horns, for you to press it's breast.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwah ne u pasen er, orgen ngu yan ican, orgen ngu zuan a mtsera sha ican la. Shie gen or za kem kwase orgen ngu tsan amin. Kwase ugen ngu hulan sule kwase ugen ngu timen iyogh yan.

tiv_text: Aondo tsar wan la ashano ken ityő a nenge tar yem ca.

deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er kwagh ne sha u tesen er mfe u wan la ka u marami, ka sagh a tsaha wan la ye. Kwaghfan la ka Aôndo iyol Na a ne ye, ka or ga.

tiv_text: Bua u alu a tsa ga Aôndo hur un iji iyolna.

deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen er or u nan lua orwasen nan ga, shin nan mar wan ga, shin nan gbe iywan, Aôndo un a wase nan.

tiv_text: Se kpen m ese u Jembe se va gber mule.

tiv_text: Ka we a sôron ijua i kpen u ver ikyur ikyua.

tiv_text: Ka we a koron kooso u ndiar tsur.

tiv_text: Ka we a eren belanda u mkee u kera aan ityô ga.

deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er kwagh ne u tesen iyolparegh man mlu u sulaa sha hanma kwagh u uwe ave yô. Tese er u ngu yan kwagh a mbahyomov ou nahan u lu sulaa sha er or nan a de va bulan we ga yô.

tiv_text: Akor a ngô Ivyo nga nduur Kpev yav ga.
english_translation: The horns of a doe (she-goat) do not hurt the buck (he-goat).
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er inja kwagh ne u tesen er kwagh ka un a doo u ishima yô u nengen a iyolnyoon ga. Dooshima tesen avav ga. Dooshima hidi jime sha ican kpaa ga.

tiv_text: Mumu baver cii ve avie ga.
english_translation: Tom Brown does not bubble before it is cooked.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen er, saa ior awa zwa sha kwagh cii man ve a kure ga. Shin saa ior ve a lu hen kwagh cica man a hii ilyam ga. Shin saa ior ve a fa kwagh hen ya cica man ya un a doo ga.

tiv_text: Ka hen ya u orcian-kwagh ka i zua a ikonogh ki teman ôron ijir i ortaver shima ye.
english_translation: It is in the house of a coward that a seat is found to judge the fearless.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen mdoom ma ivolparegh. Ka u tesen liba i mhidi u iyol jime. Mba tesen er ka we a lu nomor yo, shiegen i va nande ya wou cica, ankwagh teman kpa i zua a mi u teman ga. Shiegen i tsee kpishi u teman a tema hen ya wou kpaa. Ka i lu hen ya u or palegh ivol ne i fatyô u teman lamen sha kwagh wou ye.

tiv_text: Mba burun tar sha ihyô i esen ga.
english_translation: They do not butcher the world with the sharpest knife.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u pasen er doo u fankwagh been ga. Shiegen ka u nungwa ibumegh sha mi keng ve tar u doo ye. Shiegen u fa kwaghje kpa u de or wa u kwagh ve i doo ye.

tiv_text: Atsem u esen kpishi vihin kôngo utyo.
english_translation: A razor that is too sharp is likely to wound the scalp.
deeper_meaning: Heen kpa Tiv mba kaan er, kwaghfan-tsoron ka kwagh bo. Ka we a tese wer u fa kwagh tswen u va kar jindi kwagh. Tese er se fa kwagh kpa se hide a iyol jime, tar a hemba hômon.

tiv_text: Mtema toho vea or houbar inyam i bunde m keren ye.
english_translation: I went hunting with a man suffering from tuberculosis; that is why I returned without any game.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen ndor wan u dedoo ga ka u va a ikyôrbo. Tese er ka we a dondo ya vea ormbaiv yo u zua a mtsera ga, shin shimavihin. Shi injakwagh la tese er ka we a ya ijende vea orfyer yô we kpa i henen er u ngu orfyer, nahan mtsera a bunden we u zuan a mi sha dondo wou la.

tiv_text: Wan ka nan a nder pepe, a nor ijua a tile hen iyue, ngô u fankwagh ka a tôô iyue sha.
english_translation: When a little boy wakes up with an erection and stands close to a pot of soup, a wise mother quietly moves the soup away.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne sha u tesen numkõron. Shi ka u tesen tsôngo shima u organden hen ya. Ka u tesen u tsengan nengen u organden ken hemen. Injakwagh ne tese er kwagh u organden nan nenge a mi wanye nan a lu sha kon kpa nan a nenge a mi ga.

tiv_text: Ukuma girinya je u tindi ishôm ye.
english_translation: Whoever chooses to dance Girinya must be prepared to carry a cutlass.
deeper_meaning: Girinya ka amar a ken Tiv, man saa iyange u lu ortavershima ve u vine girinya ye. Shi iyange i vinen amar ne sha ishôm. Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u kaan er u ngu a iyolwan sha hanma mtaver cii ve u hii kwagh ye. Saa u lu a agowan iyol sha mtaver u hanma kwagh ve u hii ye.

tiv_text: Kurugh fa Igbyanger i ityô na amen awen ye.

deeper_meaning: Tiv mba hembe õron injakwagh ne u pasen ishimataver. Ka u vande gbilen kwar a shima you cii ve u hii kwagh ye. Shi ka u tesen er or a vande nengen agee a nan man nan a hii kwagh ye.

tiv_text: Mtume idyu a ityô ga tsō m mena iwen yö ka taver ape karen.
english_translation: I swallowed stones without consulting my anus; now I am in trouble.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba hembe oron injakwagh ne er ka afanyő a vaan nahan. U tesen er or vande wan iyol sha zayol ga tso zayol va tser nan. Shi tese er mbamtaver mba ve va tser u la we a vande fan yô, ma u we iyol sha mi.

tiv_text: Mba undu mba til sha rwam man i ye ga, hide jime.
english_translation: You do not climb onto the food before you eat it. Step aside.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba hembe öron kwagh ne u wan kwagh. Sa u kporom u sosum ken kwagh ve u nenge ga U tile ken ca kpa u kure kwagh. U kaa a kaa imo tseegh kpa ia za kure kwagh. Saa u za iyol you ga

tiv_text: Iywa i tee kuhwe ka i tswam igen kpishi.
english_translation: A dog carrying a bone dislikes the company of another dog.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen ieren i orwanbo Ka or za kwagh keren ve a anngbyan nan a za zuan a mi yô nan gba tswamen anngbyan la. Ka pe iywa kpa ka i er je ra.

tiv_text: Ka iywa i i bende Adendem ahenga sha igyundu la ia vaa ahenga ye.
english_translation: The dog that puts its nose on a hedgehog's back will be the one to cry for its nose.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen ieren i oragee. Ka u pasen er or u nan lu a agee nan suen agee ga, ka nan lu viing ka or u nan va bam nan la nan a vaa iyol ye. Shi ka u tesen er ka mfe shio ka or za bam or u lun a tahav ye.

tiv_text: Ka iyo i nyom Kurugh anyi sha igyundu ia vaa anyi ye.
english_translation: The snake that bites a tortoise on its shell will be the one to cry for its teeth.
deeper_meaning: Injakwagh ne tese ishimataver. Ka u tesen er weu wa ikyo a ican ga, ka mba eren we ican la ve a mem ga ye. Shi ka u pasen wer, u vande taver ishima ka mba eren anger sha we la u zungu ve ve we u ngu a iyol i tseen sha kwagh môm môm ga.

tiv_text: Organden nana tema hen ityõatee, ivyo ia mar hen kor ga.
english_translation: An elder does not sit under a hut and allow a goat to give birth with a rope around its neck.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba hembe õron injakwagh ne u tesen ieren i sôron tar, shin u kôron num. Ka u tesen er doo u orkaven kwagh nan a lu ve tar ua gba gban nahan ga. Ka u tesen er ieren i organden ia lu kposo a i mbayev. Tiv mba er kwagh ne zum u organden ka nan a er ieren i bee i mbayev yô. Zum u kwagh a lu zan u vihin man organden nan we zwa ga yô, injakwagh ne ka i kuma sha mi tsembelee.

tiv_text: Wan ua ker ter na a ver sha tyo er un a ta nya yô, ake a ter na ka a pir un ashe a nenge a inya ga.
english_translation: A child who lifts his father to throw him to the ground will have his father's testicles cover his eyes not to see the ground.
deeper_meaning: Mba er injakwagh ne u wan mbayev kwagh sha u civir uter vev. Ka u tesen tahav mbu orvesen shin teru a lu a mi sha mbayev yô. Ka u pasen tahav man kwaghfan u organden a hembe u mbayev yô. Shi ka u pasen er alu wan shin wanye ngu a icihi sha ter yô, ikyôr ia lagh nan ga shin nan a nenge a mzehemen ga.

tiv_text: Mba kaan a igyanden or er "kar sha mnyi kera" ga.
english_translation: You do not tell an elder to move away from the smoke.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u pasen er saa a wa orkaven-ishigh kwagh sha aeren a cuku ga Organden ka nan fa kwagh u nan a er hanma shie u kwagh a tser nan yô.

tiv_text: Ka we a yesen Anyam wan uye atuul ga.
english_translation: When nursing a lion's cub, you do not eat okra.
deeper_meaning: Injakwagh ne tese mdoom ma dondo. Shin u dondon vea or u na lu a kwagh ave yô. Anyam ka inyamkyume i eren ikyōr kpishi, tese er a lu or nana lu yesen Anyam wan yên nan a yaan inyam hanma shie. Tese er a lu u ngu ijende vea ornyar yó inyaregh ki a ban u ga.

tiv_text: Kwase u fankwagh ka un a tema tswen kpa a wa ikyondo anam, saa nomso ve a lu ga.
english_translation: A wise woman covers her thighs even when she is alone, not only when men are around.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba ôron injakwagh ne u tesen iyol-kôron-tsaha. Tese er or a vande sõron ya u nan cii ve vanya un a va ye. Ka u tesen er, we u vande karen iyol sha hanma kwagh cii ve u gba ami tembe ye. Ka u vanden lun a ago a wan iyol sha er kwagh un a bur u a bur ga yô.

tiv_text: Ka a jiidi mngerem aciin ape wan a dugh yô, аре akôngo a dugh la kpa ma za bende.
english_translation: When they press a woman in labour, the hot water reaches the place where the stool comes from as well.
deeper_meaning: Ngun ka u kaan er ka we a ya ikyar vea or nana zua a kwagh we kpa kwagh a ban u ga. Ka a er a or dedoo wea lu ikyua we kpaa erdoo la a bende a we. Ka injakwagh ne imiôm Tiv ka ve kaa er "mba a kar a ku hen we, u haa mlyam ashe ye".

tiv_text: Nor ngu ken toho kpa a yange mbahyev zende ga.
english_translation: The elephant may be in the bush, yet it does not stop the rats from roaming.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u pasen er mlu wou a de yinan we ga. Tese er or nan a lu a inyaregh kpishi, we a lu ami a kuma ga kpa, ishima i de yen u ga

tiv_text: Ka we a dughun iginogyo u kera kor llyó ga. Mba hembe dron injakwagh ne u tesen ghashim sha hanma kwagh u usoo u eren yo. Tese er ka w a na ishima u eren kwagh yo u kera zungu lyo vihin shin kunya ga. Shin ityuhwanev kpa u kone ongo ga shin anger man ilyahan ga.
english_translation: When performing acrobatics, you no longer worry about your buttocks.

tiv_text: Organden u nan ver ishima er nan a va bee iyol nan a tema ken mule yo, nan gberen a gber ikyon ga, ka nan môör a möör ikyon.
english_translation: An elder who hopes to rest under the shade of a tree in his old age does not cut down trees; he plants them.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen vor u dedoo u veren hen ityo you. Ka u pasen er, doo u eren aeren a dedoo sha er a va zaan a we ityo yo. Inja i dedoo kai lu sha awe tseegh ga zan zan sha mbayev ou kpaa. Or a de kera hiin a hii iyongo ga kpa nan a eren a er akaa a nan mzehemen.

tiv_text: Wanivongo u amende akor a yem sha Aonde war war yongu a mon u toon.
english_translation: A sheep with long horns must surely have a neck strong enough to carry them.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba hembe aron gba hiin kwagh ga saa u vande wan iyol Shi doo er u vande fan myohom ma hanma kwagh cii u hii tom sha mi yô.

tiv_text: U ngu a ayem angahar je u ker Agômik ya ivaan ye.
english_translation: Only the man who trusts the speed of his legs shoots an arrow at a patas monkey.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u pasen agee shin tahav mbu wan iyol cii hiin kwagh ye. Agômikya ka Ikya i gban ikyōr shi vihin tu. U or keren un ivaan yô u vande fan wer ka keng u ta un yô un a zenda u, nahan ka u fan wer u ngu a ayem a yevese. Doo u vanden peven iyol you nengen cii u hii kwagh ye.

tiv_text: Ivyekpekpe lan amar ga, ka er nomkwegh atil yô.
english_translation: A cockroach is not a poor dancer; it simply cannot dances in the presence of a cock.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u pasen myina u agee. Ka u tesen er shie gen ka u fa u eren a or dedoo kpa u kera lu a inyaregh ga. Shin ka or fa er nan a kaha sule ua wase tsombor u nan kpa nan lu a akôr ga.

tiv_text: Ka we a ya ikyar a bagu ivaan ngi saan we sha kon ga.
english_translation: When you make friends with a monkey, you do not lose your arrow in a tree.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba hembe õron injakwagh ne u tesen myima u boki shin ikyar. Ka u tesen mtsera u dedoo sha ndorwan. Ka we a dondo vea ortwer yô, kwagh nyion hembe u u sôron ga. Shi tese er ka we a dondo vea ornyar, kpandegh ku hembe u u tan ga.

tiv_text: Or u soon zaryougho kera cie mte u iyough ga.
english_translation: A man who loves honey does not fear the sting of a bee.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen gbashima sha kwagh. Kwagh ka un a gbau ishima yô u kera we mbamnyion ikyo ga. Shi kwase kpa ka nana doo u shima yo, we a zua a gbidiv sha ci u nan kpa mbu nyion we ga.

tiv_text: Ngôkyegh lanen sev ga, kpa ka a kpusugh nomkyegh er ayôô sev.
english_translation: The hen knows when day breaks, but it nudges the cock to announce the dawn.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba hembe õron injakwagh ne u tesen icivir i nan organden shin orhemen. Ka u tesen iyol hiden amin jime. Shiegen wanye ka afa tar a hemba ter na, kpa ka a de er ter na a kaa imo i kuren kwagh.

tiv_text: Ka we ulugh tar u kenden kputu ken jime.
english_translation: When pulling a rope, keep dropping pillows behind you in case it snaps.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen ivyor veren i dedoo. Ka u tesen mtsera u dedoo u veren hen ityo zum u i ne u hemen yô. Ka u tesen er a lu Aóndo na u ian u zuan a afishi yô tôö anngbyanev tom er u va kera lu a agee ga kpaa ve a wasen we yo. Ka u tesen iywasen hen ior er we kpaa u va zua a iywasen yô.

tiv_text: Ukôr ikyambe man u nyagh ijande?
english_translation: You have caught the crab, and now you despise the stream?
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen misera u zuan a mi hen ior man paven ave. Ka u tesen bo u eren hen ior mba ve kende a we sha yô. Er mba pativ ka ve va zua a ishangen hen ityô man ve kera va naan ityo kwagh ga nahan.

tiv_text: U unde u daa ijande u van hungwa sha nyi?
english_translation: You have climbed up and pushed the ladder away. How, then, will you come down?
deeper_meaning: Heen kpaa Tiv mba tesen er or zua kwagh man venda er mbagenev ve de zuan a mi ga. Shin gbenda u karen zuan a kwagh la, u za zou a mi yô man u yange. Voughul er i tôô or tica man nan venda er i de kera tôôn orgen ga nahan. U vihi ityough a ior mba ve ne u lu kwagh yo mzehemen wou kera ngu ga.

tiv_text: Mba we ijer bar man i men ga. Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u pasen er, saa kwagh un a doo cica man a er kwagh a mi ga. Saa nduhwar ua doo cica man a kaha sule a mi ga. Ka u kaan er, hanma kwagh yô ka ishima taver shin ishima wan ve u kure ye.
english_translation: They do not put salt on saliva before swallowing it.

tiv_text: Ka we a naan orapirashe imenger u ngu tuhwan nan.
english_translation: Giving a blind man a lamp is an insult to him.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u yangen apera a kaan. Shin imbwase i kaan orywan.

tiv_text: M ngu sanen we iyou u tema shin nya u ngu tômon mo ake.
english_translation: I am roofing your house, yet you are below trying to pick my testicles.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen u yiman or ve nana mem wegh a we yô. Tese er m ngu wasen we, we u ngu henen kwagh sha mo u bo. Kaha ga er utsõngo or, nan hide ker u kwase.

tiv_text: Bagu u a ye ikyuleke ikô, ngu a ityôndousu shin gbor.
english_translation: A monkey that eats raw maize carries fire in its stomach.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba kaan er cii man u hii kwagh yô u vande wan iyol sha uzayol mba ve a va due ken kwagh la yô. Ka u kaan er hanma ieren ngi a icigh ki sôron i.

tiv_text: Tar doo je nomkyegh kpa tôngo hen zwa u anyamkyegh
english_translation: The world is at peace, even a cock can crow in the presence of a fox.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen er bem gba hen tar, shin iyongo i anngbyanev la i bee. Ka u tesen dooshima u vesen hen ior.

tiv_text: Idyenger ne i gôvor ka ken ityev je, ka er i kur a mi ga.
english_translation: This curled bean curled while it was still in the field, not after it was brought home.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u pasen er kwagh la vihi ka ken mgbe na je. Ka u pasen er ka or u yan nan va a kwagh la ka pe yange vihi je la. Ka pe uke ve er un daang je la.

tiv_text: Nyonbua i teen bua ga, ka Orfelani a teen bua ye.
english_translation: Cattle egrets do not sell cows; the Fulani man does.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er kwagh ne u paregh iyol sha kwagh u a lu u ve ga yô. Shin u pasen er or wa awa ndor a or u nan lu a kwagh yô.

tiv_text: Ka mtaver u ahumbe beba jõndo ave sha tembe ye.
english_translation: It is because of the strength of the wind that the discarded calabash finds its way back to the compound.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er kwagh ne u vaan afanyō sha ieren i va dugh ken igbyar man i doo ga yo. Ka u pasen er hemba a hemba man inja ieren ne i va dugh ye. Shi shie gen mba kuhwan amar man doo orhyundu un kpa tsue gba ken tembe nahan, tese er ahumbe taver kpishi ve bebajôndo a ve ye.

tiv_text: Tondo ikusenegh sha man me tee an-iywa.
english_translation: I must remove the tick before I sell the dog.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne sha u tesen er u kaan imo yange kwagh oron u zan hemen ga. Shin u umbur or shember kwagh u i hungur yange kwaghoron ga. Shi ka u soron kwagh ôron ivol man a due a mi ken igbyar ye.
corrected: split from unlabeled text embedded in #77 commentary (positional)

tiv_text: Aza gbidye an-iywa ken won tso un a fa iyou.
english_translation: Beat the dog outside, and it will know its home.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u wan kwagh hen mba ve umbur ityö shin mba ve umbur pe ve dugh ga yo Shi u kaan er tar ka ua doo or nan umbur ityo shin anngbyanev mba nan ga saa ka nana za gba ikyaa. Ka we yaan wea umbur ior ou ga, man kwagh un a za tser u wea za va hen ior ou yo, Tiv ve ör injakwagh ne.

tiv_text: Aniywa gema ku orya kpa 'sha'.
english_translation: When a dog is on the verge of death, even its owner knows.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen er for ve paregh kwagh u a lu u ve shie u a za zou a mzayol yo. Ka u pasen er orumace nyiman or shie u kwagh a tser nan yô.

tiv_text: Pe hur a zou a kwese a kese mngerem a maa imôndo la, we Aôndo a nau ikyese kpa u maa iyou.
english_translation: Wherever the termite finds a fish trap to fetch water and build its mound, if God gives you even a basket, you too can fetch water and build a house.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen man nan msurshima ken ican shin kwaghtseren. Ka u kaan er alu Aôndo na nyamtoho mfe u eren kwagh yô, we u Aôndo a er u sha ibyeen Na ne un a nau sha ikyo ga kpa u gande a ve. Ka u tesen agee a Aõndo kpaa sha uma cii.

tiv_text: Ka or u nan gbe ivav nan fe er iji i lu a anyi ye.
english_translation: Only the man with a wound knows that a housefly has teeth.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u kaan er ka or u nan lu a mzeyol la nan fe mnyion u zayol la ye. Ka u kaan er, u tema u kenger kwagh ken ica yô u fa wer ka beerkwagh, saa kwagh la un a bende a we.

tiv_text: Ngô u a gbidi akpaciecie (kpado) wan a yav, kera koho gbangi ga.
english_translation: A woman who sings a lullaby before her baby falls asleep no longer needs to beat the basin.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er kwagh ne u wan kwagh sha u yangen ayôôso a daang daang. Shi ka u tesen er ka we ker kwagh we a va zua mi yô u kera lamen apera we a va saa ga. Akpaciecie ka kwagh u kumbur mbayev a mi, mba gen mba yel er 'kpado' ka we a gbidye a wa icam yô wan a gba mnyam, a lu u hide u za bende gbangi man a er ayôôso yo wan un a nder. Gbangi mbagen mba yel er 'Tasa'. Aluer u nôngo a zayol yô, u kera kumbur eren we shi a nder ga.

tiv_text: Ibumenyon ka un a purugh hen inya a za tema sha imiôndo yô a gbidye akper je er un wundu inya.
english_translation: When a foolish bird flies from the ground to a termite mound, it flutters its feathers as though it has leaves the ground.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u yangen iyol kenden sha. Ka u tesen er or a umbur ape nan dugh ve nan va lu pe nan lu la. Ka u kaan er ape u tem la kpa Aõndo Un a kaa imo u gbajime. Ka u wan kwagh sha er we u umbur ityô, shin mba ve ne u akper u lu purugh la. A lu u umbur pe u mogh ma pe u za tem ga yô, hingir ibumegh.

tiv_text: Ishu i i shav zende i za gbe sha tar, ka i kure zende shin ikyese i orkôron ishu.
english_translation: A fish that walks onto dry land always ends up in a fisherman's basket.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba hembe ôron kwagh ne u wan gumor kwagh sha zende u daang daang. Ka u kaan er alu i saan we iyol ken tar gande yo u za kure ken ku Alu u kpen mdoom ma tar man u kera kôr iyol tsaha ga yô u za kure a doo ga. longoga ka i na u za nyór ken zayol.

tiv_text: Wan hungwaja u fan kwagh pin ngô na ihyuugh ki un a ya ve un a lu uma ga.
english_translation: A wise cricket does not ask its mother which leaf to eat to stay alive.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen mfe u maramin. Or u i mar nan a kwaghfan yô nan pin a pine er nan a er a or dedoo ga. Hanma ieren i or eren yo ka er i mar nan je, shie genegh u nôngo nan kpa u fatyó u geman ga.

tiv_text: Anngôm we u ngu shin mnger se mba sha tar eren "tôtô kper we a due yô".
english_translation: (Missing in the original list.)
deeper_meaning: Tiv ka ve ôr kwagh ne u kaan er anngôm mo m ngu hen ijiir la ga, kpa we u ngu nahan hanma kwagh u u va a mi yô, me ngohol.

tiv_text: Wanye u asember ken ityev lanen pe i yer ijembe ga.
english_translation: A child who leaves the farm late knows where the axe is kept.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen er or u nan wundu kwagh ica i gbe ga nan a hemba lun a mfe u ijiir la. Ka de voogh er or u a sember memen shoja un a lan gbuuka u keren ga nahan. Or u a we ndor shin or u a tem ya hen kpe uagher lanen ue ga.

tiv_text: Ka alu pe kasua un a vihi u yô, tsa vea tor-kasua kpa kpernan kasua anum sha we.
english_translation: If misfortune awaits you in the marketplace, even if you sleep in the same house as the market leader, when trouble breaks out, it will begin with you.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er kwagh ne u tesen iyol bo. Ka u kaan er ka we a lu a iyolbo yô pe nôngon a mi ngu ga. Shin wea ker gbenda nan nan kpa Aõndo A soo er kwagh la a er u yô u war ga.

tiv_text: Ka me vine amar shin mnger kpa ior ve vaa er mo mngu eren ihyundu.
english_translation: Even when I dance in the water, people still complain that I am raising dust.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er kwagh ne u tesen er ior ka ve a soo u tswamen we yô ieren you cii i lu a mshi sha mi Heen kpa ka u tesen iyolbo i lun a mi. Shi ka u tesen ishoon i ior soon we ga, uerdoo ou mbala cii ka ve gema ve hingir iyongo.

tiv_text: Mtsuwa anyi mer me yange ityô yam igboghahi i kahan ga.
english_translation: I have removed my teeth, but not to stop my people from farming bambara nuts.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u pasen myange u iyuhwe. Ka u vendan iyuhwe hen ityō. Inja na yô a u wase õnov mba iorov shin alu lu u mar ga kpa sha makeranta u kimbin kpaa. Tese er wea lu a kwagh ga kpa taver mba ve lu a kwagh la ishima

tiv_text: Akpa u kenden sha yange m-ande u ihyev ga.
english_translation: The raising of sticks does not stop a rat from running out.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen er kwagh u igbe a pe un a er yô un a er, shin alu sha ishima yase ga kpaa. We a ker u yangen nan nan kpa un a er.

tiv_text: Alu bagu hii yongo yo ikyarakya kpa i a zende ga.
english_translation: If bamboo seeks trouble, even monkeys will not be allowed to move freely.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen mgem u iyongo sha anngbyan man boki. Shie genegh angou ka un a zua kwagh vea or nan a va nenge a we kpa i bee nan er ka or la nahan. Bagu man Ikyarakya ka tsombor môm, taver u fan mkposo.

tiv_text: Undyartorityu, haren gbegba ga.
english_translation: When you walk with a king, you do not dress like him.
deeper_meaning: U-ndyartorityu, ka or u zenden vea tor. Un kera woho iyol er tor ga. Gbegba gema ka ikyav i or u been akombo a Tiv cii ka nan har yô, iyange Tiv ve na tor-akombo u tesen er or môm nan kuma sha nan ga. Tor ne iyange a bee hanma kombo sôron cii nahan a hingir tor, shi a haren gbegba. Injakwagh ne ka u tesen er, u lu zenden ve a tor kpa u gema u ngu tor ga. U hool ve a or tese u tôôn hemen u nan ga.

tiv_text: Wanye u ate ahungwa kor yô, bua sar un.
english_translation: A child who ties a grasshopper with a rope is dreaming of owning a cow.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen ikyav i kwagh sar u. A lu or ngu kohol ior hen ya u nan yôron, tsô man u fa wer tor sar nan. Shin wanye hii u kahan sule man u fa je wer nan soo u eren kwase.

tiv_text: Wanye u a hende igyacor a dugh a mi sha tembe, shagba u nyinya sar un.
english_translation: A child who rides a raffia branch home dreams of owning a horse.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen ikyav er a lu u zua a kwagh cuku man u er a mi tsembelee yô zege na kpa a nau kpa u fatyô. Ka u kaan er ieren you yev ka i tesen inja i or i u va lu yô. Tese er sha aeren ou ka ifa injaor i u va lu ken hemen yô.

tiv_text: Ortato u aver ishima u yan iyouv mbihyev sha inyam begha tse ku ga.
english_translation: A hunter who wishes to eat new yam with lion meat dies young.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen er a lu or ver ishima ueren uzege mbaakaav yo ayange a nan ka a pande. Shin u har shima sha shagba faa yô u tsa ku ga. Shie gen u lamen a mbaganden, shin orvesen sha icihi yô Tiv ka ve kaa er, u ngu yan nyam begha. Tese er orhagher sha akaa tsek ku ga

tiv_text: Annyon u a tem imiongo sha kor, lanen amar a korogh ga.
english_translation: A bird that perches on a rope knows the dance of the rope.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er kwagh ne u kaan er hanma kwagh u u we ave yô u lanen ayom na ga. Shin or ka nan a zaan ikyua a kwagh je tsô nan lanen inja i kwagh la ga.

tiv_text: Annyon u a lu vinen amar hen gbenda, ka a yer ior mba ityoulugh nav ken toho.
english_translation: A bird that dances by the roadside keeps its drummers in the bush.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u pasen myerenem ma or uma. Ka u tesen er alu or ngu suen num a ikpilaior yô fa wer nan yel mba nôngon num shin gbenda Shin a lu wanye za tuhwa igyanden or yö alaghga orvesen u gen tindi nan er nan a za hii iyongo nan ngu her. Aluer or ngu suen kwagh yô nan ngu a ishuur.

tiv_text: Ka we a tunan bar u kpeher sanger.
english_translation: When you deny having salt, you open your storehouse.
deeper_meaning: Tiv mba er injakwagh ne u tesen jyol palegh man perapera hen ityo. Ka u tesen wer u ngu eren kwagh ken myer ga, ieren you ngi waang u yer kwagh mape ga.
